hero.intro: Spaces with attitude. We design interiors and furniture that unite function and calm.

studio.title: One studio, one point of contact, one standard.
studio.text: Studio von Boros is my practice for interior architecture and bespoke furniture in Berlin. I plan, draw and oversee the build myself — from the first measurement to the mounted front. The focus is the untapped potential of urban apartments: considered built-ins, honest materials, and spaces that make everyday life easier.

about.title: Daniel von Boros
about.lead: Architect in Berlin. I design interiors, built-ins and bespoke furniture, and see them through to the mounted front.

sections.title: From the whole to the detail
sections.text: I studied architecture and bring more than 5 years of professional experience as an architect with me. One habit I developed: I think about a space as a whole before I draw the first piece of furniture. Proportion before decoration.

sections.title: A detour through software
sections.text: After that I spent three years as a software developer. It taught me to structure processes clearly and to record decisions precisely. My plans benefit from it today: unambiguous, complete, buildable.

sections.title: One studio, one point of contact
sections.text: Studio von Boros is deliberately small. I plan, draw and oversee the build myself, from the first measurement to the mounted front. For wood and metal work I collaborate with a partner workshop that builds from my detail drawings. One person stays responsible, from the first line to the last joint.

sections.title: What I work on
sections.text: My focus is Berlin's period and loft apartments: high ceilings, alcoves, walk-through rooms, spaces that should do more than they do today. Typical tasks are a home office in an alcove, a room divider between living and sleeping, a loft bed with desk and storage, or a material and colour concept for the whole apartment.

sections.title: What I care about
sections.text: An intervention should not look like a renovation, but as if it had always been that way. That is why I work with honest materials, calm proportions and the light that is already there.
